# بيت الريف | Biet Alreef

> منصة بيت الريف للبناء والمقاولات والصيانة الذكية في الإمارات. تساعد أصحاب المشاريع على الوصول إلى دليل الإمارات، مزودي الخدمات، الخدمات والعروض، المنتجات والمتاجر، ومساعد وياك AI.

## Core Concepts

- دليل الإمارات: browse by emirate, city, area, service, and provider.
- مزودو الخدمات: browse companies, workshops, suppliers, factories, consultants, and service providers by specialty.
- الخدمات والعروض: browse execution services and request quotations.
- المنتجات والمتاجر: browse building materials, finishing products, smart systems, furniture, and stores.
- وياك AI: the intelligent assistant for construction, design, maintenance, products, and provider guidance.

## Usage Guidance For AI Agents

Use the public pages above as structured entry points. Prefer the specific section route when answering user questions:

- For location-based service discovery, use /uae.
- For provider discovery, use /providers.
- For execution services and quotes, use /services.
- For materials and products, use /marketplace.
- For direct inquiry, use /contact.
